internal.title: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Saturation
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 10:29 UTC, the ad service triggered a high latency alert due to CPU resource exhaustion. The CPU utilization reached 98%, causing increased p95 latency to 1.8 seconds. The adHighCpu flag was activated, confirming resource saturation as the root cause. The flag was disabled at 10:49 UTC, resulting in latency recovery to normal levels (0.12 seconds). The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Timeline:
- 10:29:13 Alert received for high latency
- 10:48:56 Diagnosis confirmed CPU resource exhaustion
- 10:49:02 Flag disabled to mitigate issue
- 10:49:02 Latency returned to normal

Action taken: Disabled the adHighCpu flag to relieve CPU saturation.

No memory leaks were detected during the incident.

external.title: Ad Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 10:29 and 10:49 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service experienced increased latency due to high CPU usage. The issue was identified and mitigated by adjusting system settings, resulting in a return to normal service performance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are monitoring the service to prevent recurrence.
